name: document_type
description: The type of each document, judged from its first ten pages.

questions.name: type
questions.instructions: What type of document are these its first pages of?

choices.account_book: An account book or a ledger.
choices.register: A register or a list, such as a census, an inventory or a directory.
choices.form_or_ephemera: A printed form or ephemera, such as a handbill, a ticket or a menu card.
